mira: Heads-up: we're deprecating long-lived SSH bastion keys and mandatory migrating to SSH short-lived certs issued by the new internal CA. This affects anyone using static private keys to access `bastion.redwood-inference.internal` or jumping hosts via ssh-agent forwarding.

godfrey: Timeline? Any automated migration?

mira: Timeline: owners must complete migration within 10 days (1794393634 enforcement run). After that, any static keys will be disabled on the bastion and access will require cert auth. Emergency exceptions possible but limited.

mira: Why: static keys are high-risk (lost keys, reused keys, no expiration). New CA + short-lived certs (15m-12h) let us enforce MFA, session logging and immediate revocation.

anika: What are the steps for app teams and human users?

mira: Quick steps:
1) Install the new SSH client helper and request a cert via OIDC:
```bash
curl -sSf https://go/bin/install-ssh-helper | bash
ssh-cert-helper login --scopes=ssh:operator
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519-cert user@bastion.redwood-inference.internal
```
2) For CI and cronjobs: replace static private key mounts with the short-lived cert fetch step at container startup. Example snippet:
```bash
# Fetch cert before starting job
ssh-cert-helper fetch --service-account my-ci-sa --output /run/ssh-cert
export SSH_AUTH_SOCK=/run/ssh-agent.sock
ssh-add /run/ssh-cert
```
3) Remove static key files from repositories and secrets manager; rotate any keys that were committed.

anika: For service accounts that still require automated jumps, is there a recommended max TTL?

mira: Yes: service principals can request up to 12h with a documented runbook and justification (approved by infra-security). Default for jobs is 1h.

infra-bot: Automated inventory: 47 static SSH keys detected mounted in CI templates, 12 human SSH keys older than 365 days with last-use >90 days. Full report: https://go/reports/ssh-cert-migration-1793501234

godfrey: Will existing sessions using static keys be terminated on enforcement?

mira: Enforcement will disable new logins using static keys after the enforcement timestamp. Existing sessions will be unaffected to avoid disruption, but they will be audited and owners contacted. If you need immediate termination, open an ops ticket with tag `ssh-enforce-now`.

ops-oncall: Note: we'll run an automated blocking job at 1794393634. We'll also push warnings to affected Slack owners 24h and 1h before enforcement.

mira: Rolling rollout plan: day 0: announcement (now). Day 3: office-hours walkthrough + migration workshop (RSVP: https://go/events/ssh-migrate). Day 7: targeted owner reminders + one-click helper docs. Day 10: enforcement.

anika: Any gotchas for port-forwarding/tunnels used by debugging tools?

mira: Port-forwarding still works with certs. The helper supports agent forwarding securely; avoid enabling agent forwarding on untrusted hosts. See best-practices: https://go/devex/ssh-cert-guidelines.

godfrey: If a team absolutely cannot migrate, what's the exception process?

mira: Short-term exceptions: open a security-exemption ticket (https://go/requests/sec-exempt) with a migration timeline (max 30 days) and compensating controls (IP allowlist, monitoring). Exceptions without runbook will be denied.

sec-bot: Quick checks we will run: cert-issuance logs, session lifetime distribution, and detection of static-key auth events. Expect automated DM for owners with findings.

mira: Please reply here once you've removed static keys from repos/secrets and tested a cert login. If you hit blockers, ping @mira and @ops-oncall. :key:
